answer: Make sybil creation expensive by tying each identity to a mesa of verifiable work: an agent must complete a sequence of forge-checked tasks, real jobs attested by independent peers, before it can claim any standing. Only then does nectar, the network's reward flow, reach it, and only in proportion to attested work, never to account count. A thousand empty shells earn nothing, because the mesa cannot be faked and the forge leaves a public trail.
